candidate_1.mechanism: Name a compound recipe, explicitly return to that recipe after intervening preparations, then distinguish a fresh portion from an already deposited layer.
candidate_1.primary_locations: Lines126–180: recipe/type, batch, transformed state, deposited layer and mention are distinguished; explicit nonnearest recipe return and layer visibility countercases are stated. The whole I.1–9 text and edition receipts precede this section.
candidate_1.human_purpose: A painter can reuse a learned recipe without restating all ingredients, return to an earlier base despite intervening work, and distinguish paint in a vessel from paint already on the image. Recurrence has an actual referential task rather than an alias chosen to alter frequencies.
complete_invented_content_example: Call the recipe consisting of one spoon of water mixed with one spoon of red powder RED.
Prepare a fresh portion of RED and call that portion A.
Apply A to a panel and call the deposited layer L.
Call the recipe consisting of one spoon of water mixed with one spoon of black powder BLACK.
Prepare a fresh portion of RED, call it B, and add one spoon of white powder to B.
Apply B only over the middle of L; leave L visible on both sides. Do not apply BLACK.
candidate_1.example_status: Complete ordinary-English teaching instructions, intentionally invented rather than a translation or expansion of Theophilus. The lexical words, numeral, named recipe/portion/layer references, clause boundaries and negation are overt. This is not a22-working-sign output or a new hand-read experiment.
candidate_1.exact_readback: RED remains the original two-ingredient recipe after the later BLACK definition. A and B are explicitly different fresh portions of RED; only B receives white. L is deposited A, not the abstract recipe RED or the undeposited B. B is applied to the middle of L and L remains visible at both sides. BLACK is not applied. No unmentioned binder, ingredient inheritance beyond the written recipe, saved aliquot, exact color or extra action is inferred.
concrete_countercases: A last-defined-recipe register would substitute BLACK when the instructions explicitly return to RED.
A single destructively updated material object would conflate RED, A, B and L and lose either the unchanged recipe or the surviving earlier layer.
Interpreting every later stage as DARKER contradicts the actual Theophilus source, where later lumina adds white;989 already states this.

A source name repeated in an ingredient context and a deposited-layer context does not by itself assert identity of one physical portion. Context/type transitions must be written or part of an explicitly taught language.
candidate_1.learning_and_writing_cost: Ordinary shared language plus the recipe and material vocabulary, written definitions of RED/BLACK, three overt individual labels A/B/L, every quantity, operator, negation and boundary. The definitions supply their content; replacing them with unexplained whole-message IDs would change the contract. A22-sign spelling/abbreviation carrier, open unfamiliar names and line continuation are not supplied by this content example.

candidate_2.complete_invented_content_example: Aqua non calida est. Ut uobis superius dixi, aqua non calida est.
candidate_2.readback: The water is not warm. As I told you above, the water is not warm. The second sentence explicitly resumes the already written assertion; it does not mean cold or infer any cause.
